fields.name: New Practice (Startup)
fields.description: Template for new veterinary practices that need a website built from scratch.

discovery_cards.title: Complete onboarding questionnaire
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: This helps us understand your practice, goals, and vision for your website.
discovery_cards.instructions: Please complete our onboarding questionnaire to tell us about your practice, target audience, and website goals.

discovery_cards.title: Upload logo and brand assets
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: Your logo and brand colors ensure your website matches your practice identity.
discovery_cards.instructions: Please upload your logo files (preferably in PNG, SVG, or EPS format) and share your brand colors if you have them.

discovery_cards.title: Confirm business information
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: Accurate business info ensures clients can find and contact you.
discovery_cards.instructions: Please confirm your business name, address, phone number, email, and hours of operation.

discovery_cards.title: Approve sitemap
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: The sitemap defines all the pages on your website. Approving it lets us start building.
discovery_cards.instructions: Review the proposed sitemap and approve it or suggest changes.

launch_cards.title: Provide domain registrar login
launch_cards.why_it_matters: We need access to point your domain to your new website.
launch_cards.instructions: Please provide the login credentials for your domain registrar (e.g., GoDaddy, Namecheap).

launch_cards.title: Confirm email hosting needs
launch_cards.why_it_matters: We want to ensure your email continues working during the transition.
launch_cards.instructions: Tell us about your current email setup and any migration needs.

launch_cards.title: Confirm launch date availability
launch_cards.why_it_matters: We want to make sure you're available if any issues arise during launch.
launch_cards.instructions: Please confirm you'll be available on the proposed launch date.

launch_cards.title: Final approval
launch_cards.why_it_matters: Your final sign-off tells us everything is ready to go live.
launch_cards.instructions: Review the complete website and give us your final approval to launch.

fields.name: Existing Practice
fields.description: Template for existing practices with a current website that needs redesign.

discovery_cards.title: Complete onboarding questionnaire
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: This helps us understand your practice and what you want to improve with your new website.
discovery_cards.instructions: Please complete our onboarding questionnaire. Be sure to include what you like and don't like about your current site.

discovery_cards.title: Upload logo and brand assets
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: Even if we're reusing your logo, we need high-quality files for the new design.
discovery_cards.instructions: Please upload your logo files (preferably in PNG, SVG, or EPS format). If you're updating your brand, include new assets.

discovery_cards.title: Confirm business information
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: We want to make sure all your contact info is current.
discovery_cards.instructions: Please review and confirm your business name, address, phone number, email, and hours of operation.

discovery_cards.title: Approve sitemap
discovery_cards.why_it_matters: The sitemap defines all the pages on your new website.
discovery_cards.instructions: Review the proposed sitemap and approve it or suggest changes. We've based it on your current site structure.

launch_cards.title: Provide domain registrar login
launch_cards.why_it_matters: We need access to update DNS settings for the new website.
launch_cards.instructions: Please provide the login credentials for your domain registrar.

launch_cards.title: Confirm email hosting and migration needs
launch_cards.why_it_matters: We need to ensure email continues working when we switch to the new site.
launch_cards.instructions: Tell us about your current email setup and whether you need migration assistance.

launch_cards.title: Confirm launch date availability
launch_cards.why_it_matters: We want to coordinate the switch from your old site to the new one smoothly.
launch_cards.instructions: Please confirm you'll be available on the proposed launch date.

launch_cards.title: Final approval
launch_cards.why_it_matters: Your final sign-off tells us you're ready to replace your current website.
launch_cards.instructions: Review the complete new website and give us your final approval to launch.
